description: NaPr(SeO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.93 Å. Pr is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Pr-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.84 Å. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.70 Å. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (1.66 Å) and three longer (1.67 Å) Se-O bond lengths. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Pr, and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Pr, and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Pr, and one Se atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Pr, and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Pr and one Se atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Pr, and one Se atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Pr, and one Se atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Pr, and one Se atom.
